Hello, Shaa-nee-sama, nice to meet you. Good evening. I saw your illustrations on Skeb and thought they were absolutely wonderful, so I'd really like to request a commission from you. 🙏🏻 ̖́-‬ If you're willing, I'd like you to draw two original characters (OCs) for a TRPG. Their relationship is: ① Kidnapper (Seme) Height: 178cm Age: 24 A man who loves ② so much he kidnapped him. He enjoys seeing the face of the person he loves suffer, so he tortures ②. ② is his first love, and he wants him to accept him as he is, even embracing the torture. He's crazy, but he doesn't want ② to hate him and desperately wants him to love him back. He's dog-like and affectionate towards ②. Despite torturing him, he believes they can't even kiss unless they're in love. He's younger and a virgin.

② The kidnapped handsome older brother (Uke) Height: 173cm Age: 26 A handsome older brother suddenly kidnapped one day. He's an older gay man who's somewhat promiscuous. Somehow, he's become attached to ① and is using ①'s fear of being disliked to get his way, trying to discipline ①. Somehow, he finds ① cute.

Since this is the beginning, I'd love it if you could capture a slightly dark atmosphere. However, I absolutely adore your illustrations, so please feel free to interpret the composition, background, clothing, and overall vibe however you like...! I'll include reference stand-alone illustrations in the materials. This is for personal enjoyment only. I'd be thrilled if we could work together...! Thank you in advance 🙏
